summary: This is a routine 8-K filed by Hyundai ABS Funding LLC (depositor) and Hyundai Auto Receivables Trust 2026-B (issuing entity) reporting the entry into an underwriting agreement for a securitization of auto loan receivables. The notes issued have an aggregate principal balance of $2,187,070,000 and are backed by retail installment sale contracts. The filing includes standard transaction documents such as a receivables purchase agreement, trust agreement, sale and servicing agreement, and indenture. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is present. This is a typical asset-backed securities issuance and not a special situation meriting classification.
